ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.25:1 ratio of mid-to-high intensity (light grey/tan) pixels to low-intensity (dark black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, roughly symmetrical light-intensity regions are centered on the left and right lobes, separated by a high-density dark pixel column at the midline/notch area. Dark pixel masking is concentrated along the leading and trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central notch with an estimated interior angle of 105 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 12% of the fluke's total vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Frequent, low-amplitude (2-4 pixel height) irregular serrations distributed across the entire trailing edge, with more pronounced jaggedness observed on the distal halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge, sweeping upward to extremely acute, elongated, and tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Presence of small (approx. 2-5 pixel diameter) high-contrast white circular clusters scattered on the medial-distal region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct dark, high-contrast vertical linear rake marks on the right lobe, including a hook-shaped mark near the central-right quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel vertical rake marks on the right lobe indicative of previous physical interaction; minor notch-like irregularities on the trailing edge of the left lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The distal tips of the lobes are exceptionally elongated and pointed, forming a 'hook' appearance at the terminal ends.
